title: Old-text preservation review for frozen sample100 packet
question: Whether staged description_short, description_medium, and description_long preserve frozen title/synopsis text, accounting for the app projection rules.

projection_rules.rule: short summary is short_summary, falling back to synopsis; title remains a separate title field.
legacy app projection maps enrichment.title to title and enrichment.summaries.short to synopsis.
catalog query reads entry.title and entry.synopsis as separate columns.
entry page renders entry.title as the heading and entry.synopsis as the incident synopsis.

method: For each row, compared exact staged description strings with frozen_original.title and frozen_original.synopsis. For synopsis preservation, counted exact equality or a verbatim frozen-synopsis substring. The preservation declaration is read from staged_description.preserved_fields; classification is evidence about text identity, not editorial adequacy.
interpretation: Among declared description_short preservation holds, 88 are false because the staged short exactly reproduces frozen title while differing from frozen synopsis; 11 genuinely preserve the synopsis, and entry-7 is a separate rewrite that matches neither. In the app legacy projection, title maps separately to title and summaries.short maps to synopsis, so the duplicated title would become the projected synopsis; the app does not infer or restore the original synopsis from title. The medium and long results are reported separately. One declared title-preservation hold (entry-7) also does not match frozen title.
